library.title: Your library.
library.intro: Familiar faces. Inside jokes. Ready for the next round.
library.playersIntro: Save your people here, then choose who's playing when you start a game.
library.playersEmptyText: Add a name and an optional photo. They'll be here next time.
library.cardsIntro: {enabled} of {count} cards enabled. Changes apply to future games; your current deck stays the same.
library.localNote: Saved in this browser, on this device. Export a backup to keep a copy or move your library. Clearing browser data removes local saves.
library.setupSavedHint: Choose from your library, or add someone new below.
library.imageHint: Optional · JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 10 MB. Resized to fit 1200 × 800 pixels and saved under 512 KB for offline play.
library.imageStock: A stock photo is used until you add your own.
library.noOrdinaryCards: Enable at least one prompt or temporary rule before starting a new game. Special cards cannot form a deck on their own.
library.backupDeckHint: Backups include which cards are enabled. Import restores choices for built-in cards and imported custom cards; choices for other custom cards stay. Older backups keep your current choices.
